title: Whole-space eventual log-concavity and level-set geometry for the multidimensional Fisher-KPP equation
summary: We study eventual strict log-concavity and level-set geometry for the multidimensional Fisher-KPP equation with nontrivial, nonnegative, smooth compactly supported initial data, without assuming radial symmetry or convexity of the initial superlevel sets. Our main result is that there exist $T>1$ and $c>0$ such that $D_x^2\log u(t,x)\le -(c/t)e^{-β_*t}\mathrm{Id}$ for all $t\ge T$ and $x\in\mathbb{R}^N$, where $β_*=2(\sqrt2-1)$.
